content:
meera.patel: Vendor just updated PO 4532 - sea ETA moved to 11-13 weeks. They offered an air option for up to 12 units at +$1,200/unit. Can we discuss split routing and RMA implications?

sanjay: What's the lead time delta if we take air vs wait full sea?

meera.patel: Air is 5-7 days to APAC, 7-9 to EU. Sea is the 11-13 weeks single shipment.

rebecca: Cost note: air surcharge ~ $14.4k total for 12 units. Finance can cover up to $20k expedite budget for Q2 if ops justify.

dom: RMA backlog at our EU depot is ~72h processing right now. If we air to APAC then re-route spare pools, return flows might be longer because returns from APAC hit different depot.

vendor-acme: vendor-acme: Confirmed: AWB provisional EK123456789 for air. Surcharge breakdown: $1,200/unit (freight + expedited handling). For sea we will consolidate in Hamburg LCL, final manifest before load. DOA estimate historically ~1.2%.

meera.patel: Important: vendor can pre-print RMA labels for air shipments but not for sea consolidation pallets. That affects staging time.

sanjay: If we split (6 air -> APAC, 6 sea -> EU) does sea still get pallet manifest early enough to attach labels at our EU depot?

vendor-acme: vendor-acme: For sea we can provide pallet manifest 48h before vessel cutoff, but labels need to be printed by consignee. We can include packing lists inside each box.

rebecca: Finance: approve partial air if it's critical to hit capacity SLAs. We want a clear allocation plan showing which clusters get the 12 expedited units.

dom: Ops question: which clusters get priority? APAC training clusters or EU inference fleet?

meera.patel: Priority: 8 APAC (training hotspots), 4 EU (inference spare pool). Proposed air allocation: 6 units to SIN-DC for APAC, 6 units by sea to HAM-DC for EU — with option to re-route air to EU if needed (higher duty).

sanjay: Quick calc: air surcharge 12 * 1200 = $14.4k. Opportunity cost if we miss reserved capacity ramp — estimated $45k/week in affected seats. So partial air seems cost-effective.

rebecca: OK approve 6 air to APAC (covering 75% of immediate training demand). Hold remaining for sea unless dom escalates.

procurement-bot: PO 4532 status: partially-air-shipped (6/48 air request submitted; 6/48 pending sea allocation).

dom: Ops: please add pre-authorization for RMA flow and pre-create RMA ticket templates for the 6 air units arriving at SIN-DC. We need labels attached on arrival to avoid quarantine. Example label template below: 

```
RMA: RW-APAC-2387
AWB: EK123456789
Depot: SIN-DC-3
PO: 4532
```

meera.patel: @vendor-acme can you pre-attach those labels for the 6 air units and confirm palletization method? Also confirm DOA handling (pickup + return AWB) if any DOA on air.

vendor-acme: vendor-acme: We can pre-attach labels for the 6 air boxes. DOA returns: we will arrange return AWB, but if return crosses regions import duties may apply — customer bears duty reclaim timeline.

rebecca: Flag for legal: check import VAT reclaim timeline for APAC -> EU returns, might delay refunds for customers.

meera.patel: Action items: 1) Book 6 air to SIN with AWB EK123456789 (vendor to confirm booking by EOD). 2) Vendor to pre-print + attach RMA labels for those 6. 3) Finance approved partial expedite for 6 units. 4) Ops to create RMA pre-auth RW-APAC-2387 and update allocation matrix.

sanjay: I'll update the allocation sheet and notify product leads.

meera.patel: Thanks — I'll post final AWB once vendor confirms booking. :thumbsup:
